findings.quote: We are going through a second era of machines — an era in which machines are no longer an extension of physical strength but provide spiritual wealth and knowledge.
findings.rationale: Describes machines extending beyond physical work into knowledge, suggesting cognitive automation, but does not establish whether this means AI or broader computing and access to information.

findings.quote: today they are faster and smaller, they have an immense impact on our daily lives, affecting the way we work, produce, communicate and interact.
findings.rationale: Continues the preceding description of knowledge-providing machines and a fourth Industrial Revolution; the impacts could include AI, but the passage does not distinguish it from broader technological change.
